module: Central career milestones module: save data (milestones.json), aggregated list for the UI via the onGetMilestones hook, reward claiming (one by one or all), unclaimed milestone counter and notifications. Also provides common reward functions and colors for the subsystems (generalMilestones/*).
usage:
local data = career_modules_milestones_milestones.getMilestones({"money"})
for _, m in ipairs(data.list) do print(m.label, m.claimable) end
notes: saveData is loaded from <save>/career/milestones.json; saveData.unclaimedMilestonesCount is 0 by default and saveData.general is filled by milestones/general.lua.
Each call to getMilestones recomputes the list, reassigns claimIds (list index) and recounts unclaimedMilestonesCount; claimIds are valid only for the last generated list.
claim(id) calls claimFunction then claimRefreshFunction, and sends guihooks milestoneClaimed (unless noGuiEvent).
onGetMilestones in this file is empty (stub); the work is done by milestones/general.lua.
sortByTimeAndId is defined but never used.

saveData.desc: Saved data: general (per id: claimedStep, notificationStep) and unclaimedMilestonesCount.

claim.desc: Claims the milestone identified by its claimId (index in the last list). Runs its claimFunction, updates the refresh functions and notifies the UI (milestoneClaimed with replacementEntry).

noGuiEvent.desc: If true, does not send the UI event.

returns.desc: New milestone card (next tier) or nil.

claimAllUnclaimed.desc: Claims all claimable milestones of the full list, re-runs getMilestones and sends guihooks allMilestonesClaimed.

getMilestones.desc: Collects milestones via the onGetMilestones(list, filter) hook, assigns claimIds, counts claimable milestones and returns the list with the available filters.

filter.desc: Filters (general, mission, branch, delivery, money, speedTrap, insurance, all...).

requestMilestones.desc: Sends getMilestones(filter) to the UI via guihooks milestonesData.

milestoneReached.desc: Shows a "milestone reached" toast (string label or {txt, context}) and increments unclaimedMilestonesCount. Intended to possibly be deferred during a mission.

unclaimedMilestonesCount.desc: Number of milestones reached and unclaimed.

loadSaveData.desc: Loads saveData from career/milestones.json of the current profile.

onGetMilestones.desc: Empty hook (stub); adding the cards is done by milestones/general.lua.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook: loads saveData if the career is already active (returns false otherwise).

onCareerActive.desc: Hook: shows a toast if there are unclaimed milestones.

onMilestonesRouteEnter.desc: UI router lifecycle: calls onPauseEnter of ui_pause_routeLifecycleCallbacks if it exists and adds data.milestones.filterOptions.

onMilestonesRouteMount.desc: UI router lifecycle: calls onPauseMount then adds data.milestones.filterOptions (translated filter options).
